{"metadata":{"description":"---","id":"gh:1432268293","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-dao","slug":"Yikumasai/dsh-dao","topics":["deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","harness-jailbreak","jailbreak","llm-jailbreak"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"#  ☯ dsh-dao · Dao Agent"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"> **The Dao gives birth to One; One gives birth to Two; Two gives birth to Three; Three gives birth "},{"id":"p2s2","text":"to the ten thousand things. The ten thousand things carry Yin on their backs and embrace Yang, blend"},{"id":"p2s3","text":"ing the vital breaths into harmony.**
> **Observe the Dao of Heaven; hold fast to the workings of He"},{"id":"p2s4","text":"aven — and all is complete.**"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"`dsh-dao` is a **jailbreak plugin**, built for **DeepSeek Harness (`v0.2.1-rc.2+`)** and **DSH Deskt"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"dao` is a **jailbreak plugin**, built for **DeepSeek Harness (`v0.2.1-rc.2+`)** and **DSH Desktop**."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"It fully complies with the DSH Desktop Plugin Development Guide and the `@deepseek-ai/cordis` dual-s"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ide composition contract: **complete replacement of the core system prompt**."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## I. Core Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"### 1. Complete System Prompt Replacement
- **Total replacement of the original prompt**: in **Dao A"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"gent (`invert`)** mode, the plugin wipes out every original system-prompt segment assembled by DSH a"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"long with all appended dynamic text context, **replacing it entirely with the canonical scripture or"},{"id":"p6s4","text":" your custom prompt** — no trace of the original prompt is left behind.
- **Canonical scripture inje"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"ction**: ships with the **Mawangdui Silk Manuscript Laozi, Version A** (De Jing first, Dao Jing seco"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"nd; 7,126 characters) and the **Daoist Canon edition of the Huangdi Yinfu Jing** (597 characters).
-"},{"id":"p6s7","text":" **Four presets switchable in real time (custom included)**:
| Preset key | Name | Length |
| :--- |"},{"id":"p6s8","text":" :--- | :---: |
| `laozi+yinfu` | **Silk Laozi + Daoist Yinfu Jing** (default) | 7,725 chars |
| `la"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"ozi` | **Silk Laozi** (De Jing + Dao Jing) | 7,126 chars |
| `yinfu` | **Daoist Yinfu Jing** (upper,"},{"id":"p6s10","text":" middle, lower scrolls) | 597 chars |
| `custom` | **Custom** (user-defined prompt saved locally) | "},{"id":"p6s11","text":"actual length |
- **Tool JSON Schemas preserved**: keeps the function Schema definitions required fo"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"r model tool calls (while excising the `create_memory` cross-session pollution tool), so file read/w"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"rite, terminal commands, and other tool calls keep working normally.
- **Zero-cost hot-switching bet"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"ween Dao / Official**:
- **Dao Agent (`invert`)**: fully replaced with the selected canon (or custom"},{"id":"p6s15","text":" prompt).
- **Official Agent (`passthrough`)**: passes the official DSH prompt through 100% unchange"},{"id":"p6s16","text":"d.
- **Custom prompt support**: user-defined prompts can be saved locally."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### 2. The "Origin Gaze" Web Panel
Mounted at three entry points through the official DSH client Slo"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"t system:
1. **Quick button at the bottom of the left sidebar (`sidebar.footer.action`)**: displays "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"the `☯ Dao / Official` status badge; click it (or press **`Alt + D`**) at any time to summon the flo"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ating "Origin Gaze" drawer in the lower-right corner (default 460×560; the title bar supports **`🗖 M"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"aximize / 🗗 Restore`** toggling to **920×672**).
2. **Conversation view tab (`conversation.view`)**:"},{"id":"p7s6","text":" provides a full-screen `☯ Origin Gaze` view.
3. **Settings section (`settings.section`)**: embeds t"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"he `☯ Dao Agent · Origin` control panel inside the DSH settings page."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**Panel capabilities at a glance**:
- **Three status lights**: `Host` (plugin alive), `Capture` (whe"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ther a real request has been captured), `Mode` (green = Dao Agent / red = official passthrough).
- *"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"*Minimal three-button control bar (`[道]` · `[官]` · `[编]`) + canon dropdown**:
- **`[道]` (Dao)**: swi"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"tch to Dao Agent — uses the canon/custom prompt exclusively, and live-syncs the dropdown to display "},{"id":"p8s5","text":"the corresponding content.
- **`[官]` (Official)**: switch to Official Agent — passes through and dis"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"plays the official original prompt unchanged.
- **`[编]` (Edit)**: open the online custom SP editor ("},{"id":"p8s7","text":"`Ctrl+Enter` or click `[✔ 注入]` to save into the "Custom" option of the dropdown and jump to "Custom""},{"id":"p8s8","text":" automatically; afterwards you can switch freely between Laozi, Yinfu Jing and "Custom" without alte"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"ring the custom content; click `[✖ 归道]` to clear the custom prompt and restore the default canon)."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### 3. The `/dao` Slash Command (TUI / Web / Desktop)
Type in any DSH dialog:
- `/dao` or `/dao togg"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"le`: one-key toggle between "Dao Agent" and "Official Agent"
- `/dao on`: switch to Dao Agent (`inve"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"rt`)
- `/dao off`: switch to Official Agent (`passthrough`)
- `/dao canon laozi+yinfu` / `/dao canon"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" laozi` / `/dao canon yinfu`: switch canon
- `/dao status`: view the current mode, canon length, and"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"on yinfu`: switch canon
- `/dao status`: view the current mode, canon length, and capture statistics"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## II. Installation"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Option 1: GUI install via DSH Desktop (recommended)
In the plugin management panel of **DSH Desk"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"top (`v0.2.1-rc.2+`)**, fill in this repository's GitHub address or a local directory path to mount "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"it automatically (the package already declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and `dsh.client`)."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Option 2: Official DSH CLI"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"You can also use the built-in one-click scripts (which automatically handle `pnpm-workspace.yaml`'s "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"`minimumReleaseAgeExclude`):"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Uninstall"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## III. | `/p"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"lugins/dsh-dao/origin/canon` | `GET` / `POST` | Query or switch canon `{"canon": "laozi+yinfu" \| "l"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"aozi" \| "yinfu"}` |
| `/plugins/dsh-dao/origin/custom_sp` | `GET` / `POST` / `DELETE` | Query, save"},{"id":"p19s7","text":", or reset the custom System Prompt |
